name: Gadrak, the Crown-Scourge
oracle_text:
Flying
Gadrak can't attack unless you control four or more artifacts.
At the beginning of your end step, create a Treasure token for each nontoken creature that died this turn. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, create a Treasure token for each nontoken creature that died this turn.

needs.what: a value reading the turn ledger for how many NONTOKEN creatures died this turn (any controller), e.g. {"nontoken_creatures_died_this_turn": "all"}, counted in GameState's DIES ledger update only when the dying object was not a token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: creatures_died_this_turn counts every creature death including tokens (state.py's DIES ledger update increments creatures_died with no is_token check), and permanents_to_graveyard_this_turn / cards_to_graveyard_this_turn are not limited to creatures; a creature_dies trigger setting a counter would miss deaths before Gadrak entered
